Senior Engineer, Agentic Systems (Berlin / remote DE)

Responsibilities
- Build production agent workflows with explicit state, checkpoints and human approval steps.
- Implement tool calling against real systems with strict authority boundaries.
- Design RAG pipelines with measurable retrieval quality (recall, MRR) and evals in CI.
- Ship observability for model calls: token usage, cost, latency, an audit trail.
- Own deployment verification and incident follow-up for what you ship.

Requirements
- Strong Python; experience with LangGraph or a comparable stateful agent framework.
- Experience with LLM APIs, embeddings, prompt/context engineering.
- A track record of testing AI features deterministically, not by vibes.
- You have worked with PostgreSQL and durable execution patterns.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Lead Java Engineer -- GenAI Enablement (Munich, hybrid)

You will
- Lead the backend of an enterprise platform in Java 21 / Spring Boot with REST and GraphQL APIs.
- Integrate generative AI features safely: retrieval-augmented generation, human-in-the-loop approval for AI-generated changes.
- Establish engineering practices for AI-assisted delivery: independent QA of AI output, deterministic quality gates in CI.
- Run microservices with service discovery, JWT/OAuth2 security, resilience patterns and Kafka-based eventing.

We expect
- 7+ years of Java and Spring; PostgreSQL, Flyway, Testcontainers.
- Experience with Kafka and the transactional outbox pattern.
- Hands-on with LLM APIs and embeddings; an understanding of evals.
- Mentoring and estimation experience; you can run a retrospective that changes something.

Staff Engineer, AI Coding Agents (remote, EU)

About the role
We build coding agents that change real repositories. You will design the write boundary between the model and the codebase, the approval flow, the build/test verification loop and the production verification step, and you will make sure the agent never certifies its own work.

What we need
- Deep experience with tool-calling loops and the Anthropic or OpenAI APIs.
- Repository grounding: semantic code search, MCP servers, context engineering.
- Evals for agent decisions (approve / refuse / write) and for retrieval quality.
- Durable, resumable agent runs that survive a crash without repeating side effects.
- Cost telemetry per verified outcome.
- Experience with Git-based delivery pipelines and CI/CD.

Principal AI Platform Engineer (Hamburg)

Requirements
- You have run a vector database (pgvector, Qdrant or Pinecone) at production scale with tens of millions of embeddings.
- You have built model routing across multiple model providers with automatic failover.
- You have designed LLM-as-judge evaluation pipelines for generation quality.
- You have built multi-agent orchestration with a supervisor and specialised worker agents.
- Also: Java or Python backend experience, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, CI/CD and a security mindset.

Requirements
- Java 21 and Spring Boot REST APIs with PostgreSQL.
- Kafka event streaming with the outbox pattern.
- A vector database at production scale and LLM-as-judge pipelines.

Lead Engineer GenAI (m/w/d) -- Frankfurt, hybrid

Deine Aufgaben
- Du entwickelst Backend-Services in Java und Spring Boot mit REST-APIs und PostgreSQL.
- Du integrierst LLM-basierte Funktionen: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Tool Calling und Agenten-Workflows mit menschlicher Freigabe.
- Du verantwortest Qualität und Betrieb: Observability, Deployment-Verifikation, Nachbereitung von Incidents.
- Du baust Evaluierungen für KI-Funktionen auf, damit Qualität gemessen und nicht angenommen wird.

Dein Profil
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Java und Spring; Kenntnisse in Kafka und Microservices.
- Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-APIs, Embeddings und RAG; LangGraph oder ein vergleichbares Framework ist ein Plus.
- CI/CD, automatisiertes Testen und ein Sicherheitsbewusstsein (JWT/OAuth2).
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
